# Third-party components

The published site ships these components unchanged. Each keeps its own license; the texts are in [licenses/](licenses/) and beside the fonts.

| Component | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| D3 (`d3.v7.min.js`) | 7.9.0 | ISC, [licenses/d3.txt](licenses/d3.txt) | https://github.com/d3/d3 |
| d3-sankey (`d3-sankey.min.js`) | 0.12.3 | BSD-3-Clause, [licenses/d3-sankey.txt](licenses/d3-sankey.txt) | https://github.com/d3/d3-sankey |
| TopoJSON Client (`topojson-client.min.js`) | 3.1.0 | ISC, [licenses/topojson-client.txt](licenses/topojson-client.txt) | https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client |
| FlexSearch (`flexsearch.bundle.min.js`) | 0.7.41 | Apache-2.0, [licenses/flexsearch.txt](licenses/flexsearch.txt) | https://github.com/nextapps-de/flexsearch |
| World Atlas (`countries-110m.json`) | 2 | ISC build scripts, Natural Earth data in the public domain, [countries-110m-PROVENANCE.md](countries-110m-PROVENANCE.md) | https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas |
| Source Sans 3 (`../fonts/`) | Google Fonts subset | SIL Open Font License 1.1, [../fonts/LICENSE-Source-Sans-3.md](../fonts/LICENSE-Source-Sans-3.md) | https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans |
| Source Serif 4 (`../fonts/`) | Google Fonts subset | SIL Open Font License 1.1, [../fonts/LICENSE-Source-Serif-4.md](../fonts/LICENSE-Source-Serif-4.md) | https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif |
